description: One QR badge, and the Employee it was issued to. The only fact link_badge_to_employee owns: resolve_badge_to_employee (bucket_bridge.py) reads this register, pre-fetched into a plain {badge_id: employee} map, to fill in a Bucket Log Entry's employee from the worker_badge a device scanned. A separate table rather than a field on Employee — Employee is a core doctype this app edits only through employee.py's own closed WRITABLE list (see its module docstring), and a badge is reassignable (a lost card, a re-printed one) independent of anything else about the person.

fields.description: The QR badge ID as BucketLog scans it and sends it in worker_badge. The docname.
fields.label: Badge ID

fields.description: Who this badge currently belongs to.
fields.label: Employee

fields.description: Unticked retires a badge without deleting the record — a lost or reissued card stops resolving to anybody while keeping the history of who held it.
fields.label: Active

fields.description: Why this badge was mapped, reassigned or retired — worth reading later.
fields.label: Notes
